sources.title: France Diplomatie: Afghanistan entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants français doivent obtenir un visa ... L’ambassade d’Afghanistan en France délivre des visas à entrée simple.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: North Korea entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa est exigé ... Il peut être obtenu auprès de la Délégation générale de la République populaire démocratique de Corée en France.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Libya entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les Français ... doivent obtenir un visa d’entrée préalablement à leur arrivée.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands: visa requirements
sources.publisher: Government of the Virgin Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The BVI Government publishes its list of nationalities that require a visa to enter the Territory.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of the following countries require a visa to enter the Virgin Islands; France is not listed.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Israel and Palestinian Territories entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government page expressly covers Palestine and Israeli-controlled entry for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa n’est nécessaire ni en Israël ni en Palestine ... une autorisation ETA-IL doit être sollicitée avant le départ.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Djibouti entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa peut être obtenu ... à l’entrée sur le territoire pour une durée d’un mois.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Sudan entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L’accès au territoire du Soudan est soumis à l’obtention préalable d’un visa.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Iraq entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Depuis le 1er mars 2025, le visa touristique n’est plus délivré à l’arrivée ... une demande de visa électronique doit être effectuée via eservice.evisa.iq.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Syria entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L’entrée en Syrie n’est autorisée qu’avec un passeport revêtu d’un visa délivré par une représentation diplomatique ou consulaire syrienne.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Comoros entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est délivré à l’arrivée à l’aéroport de Moroni.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Cuba entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa touristique est obligatoire ... La demande s’effectue en ligne via le site evisacuba.cu et un code de confirmation est envoyé par courriel.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Turkmenistan entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa peut également être obtenu à l’aéroport d’Achgabat ... sur présentation de l’invitation délivrée par le Service national des migrations.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Kosovo entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants français ... peuvent entrer sans formalités pour un séjour de 90 jours sur une période de 6 mois.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Ukraine entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants de l’Union européenne sont exemptés de visa pour un séjour inférieur à 90 jours sur 180 jours.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Republic of the Congo entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa doit être obtenu avant le départ ... Il n’est pas possible d’obtenir un visa à l’arrivée.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Tunisia entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants français n’ont pas besoin de visa pour un séjour inférieur ou égal à trois mois.

sources.title: Embassy of the Central African Republic in France: short-stay visa
sources.publisher: Ambassade de la République centrafricaine en France
sources.officialityEvidence: The Central African Republic Embassy in Paris publishes its own short-stay visa procedure.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Après validation, joindre le passeport et toutes les pièces demandées et envoyez le tout à l'adresse de l'ambassade pour le traitement.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Equatorial Guinea entry and stay

sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: Current French Government destination guidance for French travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants français sont dispensés de visa pour un séjour inférieur ou égal à 90 jours.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: Official guidance expressly records visa-free short-visitor access for these French ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: VG: France is absent from the BVI Government’s current list of visa-required nationalities. XK: 90 days in six months. UA: 90 days in 180 days. TN: up to three months. PA: tourist stays under 90 days. BA: stays up to 90 days.
This is the ordinary French-passport visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: Palestinian Territories access via Israeli ETA
policies.summary: France Diplomatie records an ETA-IL prerequisite for French short visitors entering through Israel, while no visa is required for Palestine.
conditions: Apply for ETA-IL online before departure for entry through Israel; the visa-free stay stated by the source is up to three months.
This does not establish access to Gaza, checkpoint opening, Israeli permit rules, Palestinian-ID-holder treatment, or final admission.

application.label: Israeli Population and Immigration Authority ETA-IL
steps: Apply online before travel using the French ordinary passport to be used for entry.
Carry the approval and comply with carrier and Israeli border requirements.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Official guidance identifies a border-issued visitor visa route for each listed French ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: a one-month visa can be obtained at entry, though France Diplomatie also lists a short-stay e-visa route. KM: visa at Moroni airport. TM: airport or port issuance requires the national migration service invitation. GA: obtain the DGDI travel-authorisation receipt before flying to Libreville Léon-Mba airport; the visa sticker and payment occur on arrival. CI: online registration and payment precede visa issuance at Abidjan airport. BD: eligible travellers apply online before departure and receive the visa at arrival for up to 30 days. KH: tourist visas are available directly at all international air, land, sea and river borders.
GA, TM, CI and BD are visa_on_arrival because the visa itself is issued at the border after an online or pre-authorisation step. This excludes final admission and route-specific exclusions.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named electronic visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Current French Government guidance identifies an electronic visitor visa issued before travel for the listed routes.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq ended tourist visa-on-arrival issuance on 1 March 2025; use eservice.evisa.iq before departure. CU: the tourist visa is mandatory and applied for online through evisacuba.cu, with a confirmation code sent by email.
This excludes Iraq’s distinct Kurdistan route, non-tourist categories, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: named advance visa routes
policies.summary: Current official material establishes advance mission processing or issuance for each listed French ordinary-passport visitor route.
conditions: AF: single-entry visas are issued by Afghanistan’s Embassy in France. KP: visa available through the DPRK General Delegation in France. LY: visa before arrival. SD: prior visa. SY: Syrian diplomatic or consular representation issues the visa. CG: obtain before departure; no arrival visa. SS: airlines may refuse boarding without a pre-departure visa and France-based applicants use the Paris embassy. CF: the CAR Paris Embassy processes the passport and short-stay application. GQ: no arrival visa and the Paris embassy states required documents. GW: French applications go to the Guinea-Bissau Embassy in Paris; its exceptional Bissau-airport route is not the standard France-resident route. LR: France residents apply through the Liberian Embassy. ML: Mali consulates in Paris or Lyon issue it; no arrival visa. NE: prior visa only; no arrival visa. NG: portal submission is followed by physical dossier submission to OIS Paris for processing. TD: diplomatic or consular mission issuance only; no border visa.
This records ordinary French-passport short-visitor routes only and does not normalize travel warnings, operational access, work, residence, special documents or final admission.

conflicts.explanation: France Diplomatie requires the visa before arrival; it does not establish an electronic issuance route.
France Diplomatie says the passport must carry a visa issued by a Syrian diplomatic or consular representation.
The visa is issued at Ashgabat airport or Turkmenbachy port after migration-service invitation approval.
DGDI requires pre-travel electronic authorisation but delivers the visa sticker and takes payment on arrival.
France Diplomatie identifies a valid visa obtained before departure and embassy processing for France-based applicants.
France Diplomatie says no visa can be obtained on arrival and identifies Paris-embassy requirements, not an e-visa issuance route.
The biometric visa is issued at Abidjan airport after online registration and payment.
For a France-based applicant, the current standard route is the Guinea-Bissau Embassy in Paris; airport issuance is exceptional and conditional.
The portal is only part of a process requiring physical dossier submission to OIS Paris; it does not establish electronic visa issuance.
